topic: After hanging 87 points on Savannah State, are the Bulldogs the class of HBCU football right now?
question: After hanging 87 points on Savannah State, are the Bulldogs the class of HBCU football right now?

entries.claim: South Carolina State defeated Savannah State with a score of 87-0.
The victory occurred on August 30, 2026, in the season opener.
South Carolina State is ranked No. 24 in the FCS.
The Bulldogs scored a total of 87 points across four quarters.
The win set a school record for points scored.
It was the largest FCS win since Idaho State defeated Lincoln (California) 90-0 in the 2025 season.
Head coach Chennis Berry is aiming to prove last season's Celebration Bowl championship was not a fluke.
The Bulldogs' next game is against Florida A&M.
